title: Open reference cup: dimensions (single source of the CAD and of the netlist geometry)
licence: CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Attribution: AcoustiLab open reference cup.
description: Every dimension of the printed parts and every geometric input of examples/reference_cup.json. Lengths in mm unless the key says otherwise. Entries with "model": true are netlist parameters of the same name, value and tolerance (checked by crates/acoustilab/tests/reference_cup.rs); geometry/dimensions.scad is generated from this file by tools/refcup/dims_to_scad.py and checked the same way. Tolerances follow docs/parameters.md (normal: the tolerance is two standard deviations). Build-check tolerances are go/no-go limits for the builder: a part outside them is remade, so the blind predictions stay valid.

print.name: PETG, 100 % infill
print.source: typical PETG filament datasheet values (tensile modulus about 2.0 GPa, density 1.27 g/cm3); Poisson's ratio an estimate. FDM parts reach a lower modulus than moulded ones; tools/refcup/wall_check.py uses these only to show a margin of orders of magnitude.

gasket.name: closed-cell silicone sponge, medium, 3 mm
gasket.source: estimate (a medium silicone sponge of about 450 kg/m3 against 1150 kg/m3 solid silicone); used only for an upper bound of the gasket's compliance

driver_outer_diameter_mm.source: datasheet mechanical drawing (Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32, Rev 1): outer diameter 39.9 +- 0.1 mm, read from the low-resolution drawing; measure the unit with calipers

driver_body_depth_mm.source: datasheet mechanical drawing: frame depth 6.5 +- 0.1 mm

driver_overall_depth_mm.source: datasheet mechanical drawing: overall depth including the rear boss 7.5 +- 0.2 mm

tolerance.source: estimate, scaled from the drawing's rear view (the boss is not dimensioned)
estimate: mean depth of the diaphragm behind the frame's front plane (not on the datasheet)

seat_clearance_mm.source: design: radial clearance of the driver bore (bore = driver diameter + 2 x clearance)

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, XY; estimate of the process)

lip_inner_diameter_mm.description: Opening of the front lip that holds the driver's front ring; larger than the effective diaphragm diameter 35.6 mm (datasheet).

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, Z; estimate of the process)
estimate: 0.5 mm closed-cell foam ring compressed by the retainer

driver_gasket_mm.description: Compressed thickness of the foam ring between the lip and the driver's front ring. It seals the path around the driver from front to rear.

retainer_inner_diameter_mm.description: Opening of the rear retaining ring: it presses only the outer 1 mm of the driver's rear rim and clears the rear vents (two holes of about 2.7 mm at a radius of about 14 mm, scaled from the drawing) and the terminals.

retainer_screws.description: M2 x 6 screws into M2 heat-set inserts in the baffle

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, XY; estimate of the process)

cup_inner_diameter_mm.description: Inner diameter of the front cavity (pad ring) and of the rear chamber.

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, XY; estimate of the process)

pad_ring_width_mm.description: Radial width of the pad ring: the length of the front ports and the width of the gasket's contact band (the residual leak's depth).

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, Z; estimate of the process)

gasket_thickness_mm.description: Uncompressed thickness of the closed-cell silicone sponge sheet (medium firmness).

tolerance.source: estimate: 3 mm medium closed-cell silicone sponge under the protocol's 5 N (1.7 kPa over the 3016 mm2 band compresses it by a few percent)

baffle_rim_mm.description: Radial width of the baffle's rim outside the cup's inner diameter (screws and sealing faces).

shell_wall_mm.description: Side wall of the rear shell (100 % infill; see print notes on wall transmission).

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, Z; estimate of the process)

rear_depth_mm.description: Inner depth of the rear chamber, from the baffle's rear face to the back plate.

tolerance.source: build check (FDM, Z; estimate of the process)

back_plate_mm.description: Thickness of the back plate at the vent port: the length of the rear plug's holes.

joint_screws.description: M3 screws on the joint circle, into heat-set inserts

joint_oring_id_mm.description: O-ring 68 x 1.5 mm (NBR) in a face groove on each side of the baffle; the faces meet, so the joints add no thickness.

shell_flange_mm.description: Flange of the rear shell against the baffle; the joint screws enter from its rear face.

cable_hole_diameter_mm.description: Driver lead exit, sealed with putty after assembly.

plug_diameter_mm.description: Plug body diameter, front and rear; ports are bored 14.2 mm and each plug seals on an 11 x 1.5 mm O-ring. Plugs are as long as the wall they sit in, so both faces are flush.

plug_clearance_mm.description: Radial clearance of a plug in its port.

drill_allowance_mm.description: Holes that set acoustics (plug holes) and the pad ring's horizontal port bores are printed this much undersize and drilled or reamed to size.

tolerance.source: build check: drilled after printing with a new 3.0 mm HSS drill, checked with pin gauges (estimate of the process)
build check: drilled after printing with a new 8.0 mm drill, checked with pin gauges (estimate of the process)
build check: drilled after printing with a new 8.0 mm drill, checked with pin gauges (estimate of the process)

front_ports.description: Front ports through the pad ring, at 0 and 180 degrees, half-way up the ring.
